description: Smooth a graph's polylines — through the vertices (NURBS/Catmull-Rom) or away from them (Chaikin).
instructions:
Smooths each polyline of an incoming graph. `interpolate` (Through vertices) on → an interpolating curve (Catmull-Rom, passes through the nodes); off → an approximating curve (Chaikin, stays away from them). `level` sets the smoothness (more = smoother). Smoothness is wireable.

TIP: use it to round a skeleton spine or a hand-drawn graph before Mitered Join.
